runbooks.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
steps: Check the pool maximum against the previous release
Look for slow queries holding connections
Raise MAX_POOL in the service environment and restart

runbooks.title: Slow query investigation
steps: Find the slowest statements
Check the query plan for missing indexes
Roll back the change or add the index

runbooks.title: Event bus and queue backlog
steps: Check downstream provider status
Pause non-critical sends
Scale consumers only if the provider is healthy

runbooks.title: Traffic surge and autoscaling limits
steps: Confirm traffic source (campaign, bot, retry storm)
Raise autoscaler maximum within quota
Enable load shedding for non-critical calls

runbooks.title: Promotion rule rollback
steps: Identify the rule set deployed before onset
Export the previous rule set from the rules repository
Re-deploy promotion-engine with the previous rule set
Confirm the error rate recovers

runbooks.title: Memory growth and OOM kills
steps: Confirm memory growth pattern
Check caches and buffers without limits
Restart as mitigation; fix the leak

runbooks.title: Ledger replay after outage
steps: Stop accrual writes at the gateway
Restore the ledger snapshot from backup-vault-eu1
Replay events from the event bus since the snapshot

runbooks.title: Certificate renewal
steps: Identify the expired certificate
Rotate through the certificate pipeline
Add expiry alerting at 30 days
